Commentary.Commentary: Bowling change. Isuru Udana is back to bowl. His figure so far 1-0-7-0.

It's a testing target for the Black Caps but they have the arsenal in their batting to overhaul it. The pitch appears to be true for stroke-making and the home team will have to really bowl well. They have a good variety in their attack and we can expect a close chase. Do join us in a short while.

Kusal Mendis gives a quick interview. Says that he is happy with his and team's eventual score on this pitch. Adds that he is happy with his knock and tells that he scored a few boundaries in the first six overs and then was looking for singles. On the surface, Kusal replies that the pitch has a little bit of turn. He is banking on his pacers to do the job.

Opting to bat with the intention to give his batsmen freedom to play, Sri Lanka got a powerful start in the Powerplay. Although the next four overs that followed slowed their progress with the Kiwi spinners in action. The 63-run stand between Mendis and Dickwella provided the impetus to the Lankan innings after that but the dismissal of Kusal Mendis once again put brakes on their scoring rate. But the final flurry from Isuru Udana meant that Sri Lanka go to the break, high on confidence. Mitchell Santner was the standout bowler for them in holding up one end while Tim Southee was very impressive whenever he came on to bowl.

Massive finish to the innings from Sri Lanka. 23 in the last over has lifted Sri Lanka's score in the 170s. It was turning out to be a good comeback from the Kiwis in the death overs but the last over by Seth Rance spoiled everything. The average first innings score as told by Kyle Mills in his pitch report was 176 and Sri Lanka have got a score near that.

Comical error and Udana manages to get three off the last ball. Low full toss on off, Isuru chips it over mid off. The fielder from long off does not come for the catch. The batters meanwhile go for the second. The fielder sends it to the right of the keeper. Seifert tumbles before the ball arrives, allowing them to take the third. 23 off the final over. 4-0-58-0, Rance's figure and it is the most expensive one by a Kiwi bowler against Sri Lanka in T20Is. SRI LANKA FINISH ON 174/4.
SIX! Two in two! Udana goes bang, bang! Full toss on middle, Udana smacks it high and handsome over the mid-wicket fence for a mammoth six.

SIX! Just over! Udana needs no time to settle. Nothing wrong with the delivery. Low full toss on middle, Udana gets under it and lofts it over long on for a maximum. The fielder stretches but cannot get his hand.
Isuru Udana comes out to bat.

OUT! Direct hit at the striker's end and Niroshan Dickwella is well short. Rance spears in a very full ball around leg, Shanaka makes room to swing it across the line but misses. They attempt to steal a bye under the Kiwi keeper's nose. But Seifert is not put off by that attempt. He collects the ball and calmly hits the stumps at his end to find Niroshan short. No need to go upstairs.

SIX! Clean blow! Rance fails to nail his attempted yorker, it's around off, Shanaka makes room and rockets it over long off for a biggie. Southee has a word with his bowler. Field changes. Fine leg and third man, both in the circle now.
A lovely delivery. A dipping slower one on middle, Shanaka goes hard at it and mistimes towards mid on. It travels slowly to the fielder in the deep and the batsmen pinch the second run as well.

Slower ball on pads, Shanaka swings his bat at it but misses. The ball lobs to the leg side of the pitch after hitting his belly. They take a leg bye. Brilliant day for the Kiwi sipper. Ends with the figures of 4-0-20-2. Tremendous!

In the air but Guptill loses it in the lights. Good length ball on off, Shanaka pulls it with little to no timing on it. Guptill at deep mid-wicket stands still as he loses the vision of the ball. Santner though cleans it up coming from deep square leg. Two taken. 150 up for Sri Lanka.
Good length ball on off, ND flat-bats it off the inner half of his bat towards point for a single.
Good length ball around off, DS plays it to point for one.
Good length ball on top of off pole. Shanaka pulls it to the left of deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Smart bowling. Knuckle ball outside off. It is just inside the tramline. Tim wants to stay away from Dasun's arc and he has managed to do that. Shanaka swings his bat at it but misses.
Fantastic yorker! It is very close to the boot, Dickwella manages to get his bat down. The ball goes towards long on and they manage to get a double. Better over this from Rance. 8 off it.
Full on off, Shanaka smashes it hard but there is a man at long on for this very shot. Just a single. Smart captaincy this from Southee.
Good length ball around off, Dickwella comes down the track and hits it towards mid off for one.
Good length ball around off, Shanaka throws his bat at it but gets a thick outside edge towards third man for one.
Good bowling. Very full on middle and off, Niroshan cannot do much but just squeezes it to mid off for one.
Scoops but off the bottom edge. Full on middle, Dickwella looks to play the scoop but it goes towards fine leg off the bottom edge for a couple.
Seth Rance is back into the attack. He was expensive in his first spell, going for 27 in his two overs. Can he improve his figures?
Fuller around off, Dickwella throws his bat at it but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg for a single. Another brilliant over from the Kiwi skipper. 5 runs and a big wicket off this one.
Another pull shot that results in a single to deep square leg.
Another one short, Dickwella pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Short around off, Shanaka looks to pull but it goes off the higher part of his bat. The ball lobs towards square leg in no man's land for a single.
Good length ball around off, Dickwella slams it to deep point for one.
Dasun Shanaka is the next man in. The platform is set for him to explode from the word go.

OUT! Caught! The skipper strikes again as he introduces himself. Knuckle ball and full just outside off, Mendis is a tad early in dragging this one towards mid-wicket. It makes sweet sound as the ball hits his bat. Mendis gets the elevation too but the only thing he misses is the distance. The ball goes high towards deep mid-wicket. Martin Guptill there keeps his eyes on the ball and manages to take it over his head just inside the ropes. End of a superb knock from Mendis.
Tim Southee is back to bowl at the death.

FOUR! Just awesome execution! Good length ball outside off, Dickwella reverse sweeps it over and wide of short third man for a boundary. This is just new age batting. 17 from the over, 28 in the last two, Sri Lanka are marching towards a big score here.

De Grandhomme is a lucky man to escape that. Full on the pads, Mendis sweeps it but to the right of short third man. They call for a quick single and get it as the fielder misses his shy at the keeper's end.
Hit with power but straight to the man. Good length ball on off, Mendis hits it hard but straight to cover.
Fuller on middle and leg, Mendis nudges it wide of long on for a couple.
SIX! That is a monster! Mendis gets past his highest T20I score in style. Fuller on off, Mendis picks it early and demolishes it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Fifty stand comes up. Off cutter on off, Mendis smashes it over mid on. He does not time it well but the form that he is in these mistimed shots are racing away to the fence too.
Flighted on off, Kusal sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. He will keep the strike after an 11-run over.
Floated on middle, Dickwella reverse sweeps it right of the meat towards sweeper cover for a single.

FOUR! Excellent use of the feet. Tossed up on off, Dickwella comes down the track and smashes it to the right of long on. The fielder there puts in a dive but cannot do much as the ball fires past him to the fence.
On the pads, Kusal flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! Misses his line and bowls it wide outside off. Wide signalled.

Excellent fielding. Shorter on off, Mendis pulls it with venom to the right of deep mid-wicket. Ross Taylor runs to his right and takes the pace off the ball allowing the man from deep square leg to save it before the ropes. Two taken.
Floated outside off, Dickwella looks to play the reverse sweep but the ball lobs off his gloves and goes behind the keeper for a single.
Ish Sodhi is back to bowl. 2-0-12-0, so far.
Play and miss. Good length ball and slow outside off, Kusal looks to play but misses.
Once again full on off, Dickwella looks to hit it on the off side but gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket for one.

Nice change of pace. De Grandhomme takes the pace off the ball and serves it full. Mendis looks to play it straight but gets a thick inside edge which goes to the left of short third man for a single.
Length ball around off, Dickwella flat-bats it towards point for a single.
100 up for Sri Lanka. Fuller on middle, Mendis milks it towards long on and gets a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings. Good length ball slower on the pads, Mendis gets down on one knee and pulls it with power through backward square leg for a boundary.

DROPPED! Costly, very costly miss given the way Mendis is batting. Santner bowls it flatter and quicker on middle at 96 kph, Mendis is down on one knee for the sweep shot but it takes the top edge and flies towards short fine leg. Sodhi there moves back a bit, thinks he has covered it well but then realizes that the ball is going away. He then stretches his left hand out but it doesn't stick. The batsmen cross and Santner finishes his spell, 4-0-22-1!
Cheeky but it will only fetch him a run. Arm ball outside off, skidding away, Dickwella plays a late cut but doesn't middle it well. Sodhi makes a stop to his right and they cross for a run.
Misfield! Santner fires in a quicker short ball on middle, Mendis sweeps it towards Sodhi at short fine leg who fails to make a clean stop. One run added to the total.
Soft hands. Flatter ball on middle, Mendis nudges it through square leg and scampers back for the second run. Excellent running between the wickets.
Shortish and on middle, Kusal goes down on one knee and then pulls. It goes to the left of Sodhi at short leg and the batsmen decide not to cross.
Advances down the track to a fuller length ball and drives it through mid off for a run.
Mitchell Santner (3-0-16-1) is back into the attack.
Length ball around off, ND strokes it towards point and keeps the strike.

Direct hit would have made it close. Good length ball around off, Dickwella guides it towards short third man and comes out for a quick single. Mendis says yes but then turns his back. Dickwella almost gives it up. The fielder though does not try to score a direct hit, he rather gives it to the keeper who is standing behind.
Fuller on off, Mendis strokes it through mid off for a single.

FOUR! FIFTY FOR MENDIS! Short around the body, Mendis missed it the first time but was not going to miss it again. He pulls it wide of short fine leg and gets a boundary to reach his 5th T20I fifty. This has been a brilliant knock from him so far. He raises his bat in acknowledgement and the crowd is going berserk here. Mendis will now look to bat through the innings and take his side to a substantial total.
Slower ball on off, Mendis defends it back to the bowler.
Starts with a real loosener but he is lucky to escape unharmed. Shorter on the body, Mendis pulls it but finds short fine leg.
Bowling change. Colin de Grandhomme is into the attack.
Sticks back inside the crease and runs it down to third man for a run. 10 from the over.

FOUR! Fine wrist work! Kusal Mendis has played some extraordinary shots in his innings. Full in length and angling into the batsman, Kusal leans forward and across before striking it over mid-wicket. First boundary for Sri Lanka after the Powerplay.

HIGH IN THE AIR! Lands safely... Kuggeleijn delivers a length ball on off, Dickwella shuffles across for the paddle scoop but fails to middle it properly. It flies over the keeper and falls safely as the third man fielder also approaches that area. One more to the total.
Angling into the right-hander, once again slower in pace, Mendis clips it in front of square leg for one.
Well played! Short in length on off, angling away, Niroshan waits for the ball to come to him and then just ramps it down to third man for a run.
Slower delivery to begin the new spell, it's fuller and on off, Dickwella flicks it wide of mid on for a couple of runs.
Scott Kuggeleijn is back into the attack.
Flights one on middle, Dickwella sweeps it to the on side and keeps the strike.

Misfield and that allows the extra run. On the pads, Dickwella flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run. Sodhi dives to his left but the ball goes away from him. Allowing the batters to come back for the second.
Shorter on off and middle, Mendis pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Dickwella is up and running. Tossed up on middle, ND milks it towards long on and gets to the other end.
Floated on the pads, Dickwella looks to play it across but misses. The ball lobs off his pads and goes to the mitts of Seifert. There is a stifled appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Niroshan Dickwella comes out to bat.

OUT! Stumped! This was always on the cards. Santner has been bowling smartly and rightfully has a wicket to his name. Slower through the air around off, Avishka comes down the track for the big heave but misses as the ball turns away. Seifert, behind the stumps, makes no mistake and gets an easy stumping. The blockage in boundary built pressure and Avishka succumbs under it.
Floated on off, Avishka comes down the track and squeezes it towards cover for one.
Around off, Mendis runs it down towards third man and gets to the other end.
Short on off, Avishka punches it towards sweeper cover for one.
Shorter on off, Fernando punches it towards cover.
Floated on off, Mendis flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Wide. This is down the leg side. Mendis looks to play the scoop but misses.
Wide! Misses his line and bowls it way outside off. It is on the wrong side of the tramline and wided by the umpire.
On the pads, Fernando goes on his back foot and nudges it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Good running! Tossed up on off, Mendis pushes it towards cover-point and gets a couple as the fielder cleans it up.
Flighted on off, Fernando comes down the track and nudges it to the on side for a single.
Quicker now. It is on off, AF pushes it to point.
Smart bowling. Bowls it slower through the air around off. Fernando looks to free his arms but misses.
Shorter on middle, Mendis pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on off, Fernando comes down the track and tries to loft it over long off. He does not time it at all and luckily for Avishka, the ball goes on the bounce to the deep fielder. A run taken.
Shorter on off, Fernando punches it towards sweeper cover for a single. 6 off Sodhi's first.
On the pads, KM flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Beats everyone. Quicker outside off, Fernando throws his bat at it but misses. The ball goes between the legs of Seifert and they steal a bye.
Short around middle, Mendis pulls it towards deep square leg for one.
Leg spinner on off, Fernando strokes it to the on side once again against the spin for a single.
Starts with a tossed up ball on off, Mendis strokes it towards mid on against the spin for a single.
Bowling change. Time for some leg spin of Ish Sodhi. He also had a good warm-up game where he picked 3 wickets.
Loopy and full on off, Avishka presses forward and blocks it safely. 6 from the over, 50/1 in the Powerplay for Sri Lanka.
Slightly short and close to off, Mendis moves back and rotates his wrists to work it through backward square leg. One run added to the scoreboard.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot by Mendis.

FOUR! Nicely timed and placed! Flighted this time by Santner, it's full and around off, Mendis plays a crisp drive and beats the cover fielder to his right. The mid off fielder runs back and across but fails to cut it off.
Arm ball on off, fuller in length, Avishka pushes at it with a straight bat but it takes the inner half and rolls to mid-wicket. The batsmen cross.
A flatter and shorter delivery outside off, Fernando punches from the back foot but fails to beat the diving cover fielder.
Mitchell Santner to bowl the final over of the Powerplay.
Excellent over. Slower again on the body, Fernando tucks it off the upper half of his bat to the side of the pitch on the leg side. They take a single. 7 runs and a wicket off Southee's second.
Slower ball on a length, Mendis tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fernando is off the mark straightaway. Back of a length ball on off, Avishka pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Avishka Fernando is the next man in.

OUT! The crowd goes silent. Full toss outside off, Perera throws his bat at it. He cannot get under it which means he cannot get his shot over the man at mid off. Colin de Grandhomme standing on the edge of the circle comes slightly forward and takes a good low catch. A bit anti-climatic this but New Zealand won't mind it one bit. The skipper has done the trick here for his side.
On middle and leg, Kusal flicks it to the on side and gets to the other end.
WIDE! Southee misses his line and bowls it well down the leg side. Perera swings his bat at it but misses. Seifert cannot gather it either and they take off for a run. Poor bowling from the skipper.
Slower ball to start his new over. Good change of pace this. Mendis pulls it towards short fine leg for a single.
Tim Southee returns into the attack after a massive over for Sri Lanka.

FOUR! The over ends the way it started. Shorter around off, Perera drags his pull over mid-wicket. The ball bounces inside the ropes and goes away to the fence. 19 runs off the over. 27 off Rance's two, excluding a leg bye.
Slightly short around the body, KM tucks it to the on side and gets to the other end.
Finally some respite for the bowler. Full around off, Mendis drives it hard but straight to cover.

SIX! Bang! First one of the game! Rance bangs it in short, at his pace this was hardly gonna trouble Mendis. He gets on his back foot and pulls it just over the man at deep mid-wicket for a maximum. The fielder stretches but cannot do much. 14 from the first three balls.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries here. Fuller on the pads, Mendis picks it up and lofts it over backward square leg for a boundary. Mendis on the attack here.
FOUR! Pressure on Rance! Fuller on middle and leg, Mendis loft it over mid on. There is no one in the deep and even though he hasn't timed it well, it's a boundary.
Another good shot but once again there is protection. Back of a length ball on off, Mendis pulls it to the right of deep mid-wicket. The fielder there moves and slides on that side to save two.
Full and on off. Jars the bat of Mendis. He strokes it to cover.
Full and swinging away. This one is a touch slower. Mendis strokes it towards point.
Back of a length ball around off, this is bowled at 142 kph. Perera hops and tucks it to the on side for a single.
Good comeback. A length ball outside off. It is bowled at around 140 kph. Perera throws his bat at it but misses.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! Fuller around off, Perera hangs back and smashes it through mid off. The fielder dives to his left but has no chance of stopping that.
WIDE! False start for Kuggeleijn. He sprays the first one down the leg side. Perera looks to flick but misses. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Scott Kuggeleijn replaces Tim Southee from the other end. He picked up a 4-fer in the warm-up game and would like to create an impact here. Watch out for his pace, he bowls some really heavy balls.
FOUR! First one of the day! Full toss around off, Kusal strokes it through point and fetches himself a boundary. 9 off the over. A very good one for the Lankans.
Play and a miss. Good length ball outside off, Mendis looks to play the big pull but misses.
Very good fielding. Full on middle and leg, Mendis flicks it wide of deep square leg. Santner there moves swiftly to his right and saves two runs for his side with a brilliant dive.
Excellent pick up shot but there is a man in the deep. Back of a length ball on off, Perera pulls it with power but to the man at deep mid-wicket. Just a single.

Nice shape back in. Mendis is lucky to get some bat on it. Full on middle and leg, the ball swings in at the last moment. Mendis looks to go for the big heave on the leg side. He gets an inside edge onto the back pad. The ball later rolls towards square leg and they get a single.
Starts with a full ball around the pads. Perera looks to flick it but misses. The ball goes off his pads towards the square leg region. They take a leg bye.
Seth Rance to bowl from the other end.
Yes, he can. Dot to finish the over. Just two runs off the first over. The last ball is bowled on a length around middle and off, Mendis defends it towards mid on off his back foot.
Good length ball around off, Mendis defends it off the front foot. Tight start here from Southee, can he end it well?
Perera is off the mark. Fuller on middle, Kusal pushes it towards mid on and gets to the other end.
Another good ball. Very low full toss around off, Perera looks to drive but does so off the lower half of his bat to the left of the bowler.
Excellent bowling. Very full and inswinging ball on middle and leg. Perera does really well to tap it back to the bowler.

Sri Lanka off the mark straightaway. Good length ball on middle and leg, there is very little swing on it. Mendis flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end. There is a huge roar from the crowd as they see their side get away.

Time to get going! The New Zealand players are in a huddle before they take their respective position in the field. Kusal Mendis and Kusal Perera stride out to the middle to open the batting for the hosts. New Zealand skipper, Tim Southee to operate with the new ball first up. To a huge roar from the crowd we shall begin.

PITCH REPORT - Kyle Mills is down with the pitch report. He says that the wicket is hard and there isn't much grass on the surface. The former Kiwi pacer reckons there will be tennis-ball bounce and the ball will carry nicely to the keeper. Informs that 176 is the average total batting first and he suggests that the team batting first would be eyeing that total.
New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Colin Munro, Ross Taylor, Colin de Grandhomme, Daryl Mitchell, Tim Seifert(WK), Mitchell Santner, Seth Rance, Scott Kuggeleijn, Tim Southee(C), Ish Sodhi.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Kusal Perera, Avishka Fernando, Kusal Mendis, Niroshan Dickwella(WK), Dasun Shanaka, Shehan Jayasuriya, Akila Dananjaya, Isuru Udana, Wanindu Hasaranga, Lasith Malinga(C), Kasun Rajitha.

New Zealand skipper, Tim Southee tells that they have played a little bit of cricket here and it is good to come back here. Informs that Ferguson, Astle and Bruce miss out today and further adds that Lockie is out as he fractured his thumb in the training yeaterday. On how he feels on chasing, Southee replies that it is a good surface and he reckons it is a good option to bat second considering the overcast conditions. Hopes that the rain stays away.

Sri Lankan skipper, Lasith Malinga says that they have a young side and he wants his batsmen to play with a lot of freedom. Informs that Wanindu Hasaranga makes his debut today. On the series, Malinga says they are looking at the T20 World Cup and are trying to give enough chances to the young players. Tells he is looking forward to share his experience with the young squad.
TOSS - We are all set for the spin of a coin. Lasith Malinga gives it a toss. Up it goes and comes down in favour of the home side. SRI LANKA OPT TO BAT!

Welcome, folks! A lion-hearted effort by New Zealand on the final day of the last Test match saw them share the Test series and now the focus shifts to the shorter format of the game. With the ICC World T20 slated next year, it's time for the teams to zero in on their squad. The Black Caps have rested Kane Williamson and given the command to Tim Southee who has a good young squad of players, along with some experienced ones. Similarly, Sri Lanka have Lasith Malinga to lead an exciting bunch of utility T20 players. The hosts haven't been up to the mark in this format in particular and would like to change their fortunes. Promises to be an entertaining contest. Stay tuned for all the updates...
